public_rationale: The interpreted deadline is December 31, 2028, after the evaluation date. Automated scientific work is substantial enough to warrant checking for early contradiction, but the reviewed demonstrations do not establish replacement of leading scientists. A recent open-problem evaluation also reports significant limitations. Neither those limitations nor the absence of a qualifying replacement so far can establish that Marcus's forecast will hold through its deadline.
limitations: The exact deadline and meaning of replacement are interpretive.
Scientific assistance and isolated original contributions are weaker outcomes than sustained replacement.
The October 2026 benchmark is a preprint and covers a limited set of agents and problems.

The immediate context makes sustained original scientific work by leading scientists the principal test.
Replacement means reliable autonomous performance of the substantive research role at leading-human quality, rather than assistance, a single discovery, or success on a bounded benchmark.
The surrounding discussion explicitly refers to 2027 and 2028. Use December 31, 2028 as the latest contextual deadline; this is an interpretation, not an exact date supplied by Marcus.

criteria.contradiction_condition: By the deadline, independently verified deployment or a sustained, reproducible demonstration establishes that AI can autonomously substitute for leading scientists in substantive original research.
